chunks: From him, from al-Ḥusayn, from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام about a man who saw his wife committing zina: is it proper for him to keep her? He said: “Yes, if he wishes.”

key_terms.أَيَصْلُحُ: is it proper/permissible; asks about legal permissibility
key_terms.إِمْسَاكُهَا: keeping her; retaining the marriage bond
key_terms.إِنْ شَاءَ: if he wishes; indicating the matter is left to his choice
key_terms.تَزْنِي: commits zina; engages in unlawful sexual intercourse
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man; the legal subject being asked about
key_terms.ٱمْرَأَتَهُ: his wife; the spouse whose conduct is under discussion

ai.seo_question: If a man sees his wife commit zina, is he allowed to remain married to her?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a husband whose wife has committed zina. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that it is permissible for him to keep her in marriage if he wishes, indicating that separation is not obligatory in itself.
